subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should authenticated hook-agent callers be allowed to opt into reusing existing stored sessions when their session keys satisfy the configured prefix policy?
rationale: The option intentionally changes external hook execution from isolated state to re-entry into persisted agent context, so automation cannot choose the permanent authorization and trust boundary.

options.title: Allow scoped persistent mode
options.body: Approve explicit persistent reuse for authenticated hooks with restricted session-key prefixes while preserving isolated behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep all hooks isolated
options.body: Disallow stored-session re-entry and update the hook API documentation to state that hook session keys do not retain transcript continuity.

recommendation.title: Allow scoped persistent mode
recommendation.body: Approve explicit persistent reuse for authenticated hooks with restricted session-key prefixes while preserving isolated behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter documented the preferred compatibility shape and is the strongest available routing candidate for the product/security boundary decision.
